```{r}
# Load the parquet dataset and inspect its structure

#== load arrow package ==
library(arrow)

#== read parquet file into a dataframe ==
df <- read_parquet(
  "data/weather_homicide_nationalagency_df.parquet" #test data
)

#== preview structure and data types ==
dplyr::glimpse(df)
```

```{r}
# Check how many rows are NA vs. non-NA for agency-level columns.

#== NA values computation ==
colSums(
  is.na(
    df[c(
      "agency_name",
      "agency_type",
      "agency_latitude",
      "agency_longitude",
      "ft_sworn",
      "agency_population",
      "validated_week_name",
      "validated_day"
    )]
  )
)
```
